about: Manuscripts Milah offers for download, generated from the OSIS headers by src/build_manifest.py in this repository. Do not edit by hand: regenerate it whenever a text is added or changes. Sizes and checksums are taken over the LF form of each file, which is what GitHub serves, so they do not depend on how a clone was checked out.

manuscripts.title: John (Vatican, Vat. ebr. 530)
manuscripts.covers: Part 1, fragment 11 of a composite volume of fragments. Folios 1r–2v carry Luke 1:1–35 and John 1:1–13 in Hebrew, each with a heading and a chapter heading.
manuscripts.shelfmark: Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana, Vat. ebr. 530, part 1, fragment 11, folios 1r–2v
